project.title: Emotion Detector
project.description: I made it using Python in Kaggle and DeepFace to analyze facial expressions in a video, track seven emotions, and visualize how they change over time. This project helped me explore how AI can interpret visual data.

project.title: RapunZpill: Clean the Spill
project.description: We turned our junior's award-winning research project from our former high school into a game using Scratch, with game assets designed in Canva. I then converted it into HTML, CSS, and JavaScript and published it on Game Jolt. It was a fun way to make scientific research more interactive.

project.title: SOLARIS: Solar-Powered Rotating Sunlight Tracker
project.description: A solar energy research project using an IoT-based sunlight tracker with efficiency enhancement and fault detection. It won first place at the Division Research Congress, qualified for the 23rd Philippine Robotics Olympiad, and earned a bronze medal at the Olongapo City Robotics Cup.
